title: HTTP Datagram and Capsule Protocol Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, HTTP/3 package build, diff hygiene, and broad-suite instability checks for the RFC 9297 foundation surface.
scope: This verification covers RFC 9297 variable-length integer use in HTTP Datagram and Capsule fields, HTTP/3 Datagram Quarter Stream ID ordering and encoding, legal maximum and H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR handling, empty payloads, associated request stream checks, SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM default/value/identifier/gating/0-RTT validation, base Capsule Type/Length/Value layout, unknown-capsule skipping by caller policy, truncated-capsule malformed-message handling, DATAGRAM Capsule type 0x00, and the registered H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR code.
preconditions: The RFC 9297 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9297.json`.
The HTTP/3 frame and settings layer exists in `src/Incursa.Quic.Http3`.
procedure: Run `dotnet test Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` and classify any failure against the changed RFC 9297 surface.
If the broad suite fails outside the RFC 9297 surface, rerun the exact failing test to distinguish an unrelated timing flake from a slice regression.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9297 foundation tests pass, the HTTP/3 package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9297 artifacts, generated triage reflects the foundation slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes. Broad-suite failures outside the changed surface must pass targeted rerun before the slice is accepted.
status_summary: The RFC 9297 HTTP Datagram, SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM, H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR, base Capsule Protocol, and DATAGRAM Capsule foundations are trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Two full solution attempts failed in unrelated existing timing-sensitive tests, `Http3MinimalServerTests.RepeatedLargeResponses_CompleteWithExactBodyAndFin` and `DoqFatalProtocolErrorTests.ClientTreatsPeerStopSendingAsFatalProtocolErrorAndClosesConnection`; each passed when rerun directly. Capsule-Protocol response/header policy, intermediary conversion, and runtime QUIC DATAGRAM integration remain future RFC 9297 slices.
